claims.description: Great war between major powers has become impossible.

claims.quote: I  maintain  that  war  has  become  impossible alike  from  a  military,  economic,  and  political  point  of view.
claims.description: A great-power war cannot be fought for military, economic and political reasons.

claims.quote: the great  war  cannot  be  made,  and  any  attempt  to  make  it would  result  in  suicide.
claims.description: Any attempt at a great war would be suicidal for the nations.

claims.quote: we  should find  the  inevitable  result  in  a  catastrophe  which  would destroy  all  existing  political  organisations
claims.description: A test of great war would cause a catastrophe destroying existing political systems.

claims.quote: the day  of  the  bayonet  is  over
claims.description: The bayonet becomes useless in future warfare.

claims.quote: in  future,  war  will  be  decided at  ranges  which  will  render  the  use  of  the  bayonet  impossible
claims.description: Battles will be decided at long range, making hand-to-hand combat impossible.

claims.quote: They  are,  indeed,  becoming  so  deadly that  before  long  you  will  see  they  will  never  fight  at  all.
claims.description: Weapons become so deadly that armies will cease fighting.

claims.quote: both  armies  will  be maintained  in  opposition  to  each  other,  threatening  each other,  but  never  being  able  to  deliver  a  final  and  decisive attack
claims.description: Future wars become stalemates of entrenched armies unable to deliver a decisive attack.

claims.quote: That  is  the  future  of  war— not  fighting,  but famine,  not  the  slaying  of  men,  but  the  bankruptcy  of nations  and  the  break-up  of  the  whole  social  organisation.
claims.description: A future war produces famine, national bankruptcy and social collapse rather than decisive fighting.

claims.quote: the  3  mm.  gun  will  probably  be the  gun  of  the  future
claims.description: Infantry rifles will shrink to 3 mm calibre.

claims.quote: the  rifle  of to-morrow  will  be  forty  times  as  effective  as  the  chassepot was  in  the  Franco-Prussian  war
claims.description: Future rifles will be forty times as effective as 1870 rifles.

claims.quote: In  the  warfare  of  the  future  men  will  simply  fall  and die  without  either  seeing  or  hearing  anything.
claims.description: Soldiers will be killed by invisible, inaudible long-range fire, harming morale.
claims.stated_time: in the warfare of the future

claims.quote: when  we  have  a  rifle  of 3  mm.  calibre  he  will  be  able  to  take  575  into  action
claims.description: Smaller calibre rifles will let each soldier carry 575 cartridges.

claims.quote: he  relied  for the  extinction  of  war  upon  the  invention  of  a  machine which  would  infallibly  slay  fifty  per  cent,  of  the  combatants whenever  battle  was  waged
claims.description: A machine killing half of combatants in any battle would make war cease of itself.

claims.quote: in which  he  attributed  the  final  disappearance  of  war  from the  planet  to  the  discovery  of  vril,  a  destructive  so  deadly that  an  army  could  be  annihilated  by  the  touch  of  a button  by  the  finger  of  a  child
claims.description: A discovered destructive force called vril could annihilate an army at the press of a button, ending war.
